note.zh: 这是程序基线，不是对 27 国实体合规的判断。
note.en: A procedural baseline, not a substantive compliance finding for all 27 states.

note.zh: 首个公开侵权程序批次；批次覆盖不等于当前状态。
note.en: The first public infringement batch; batch coverage is not the current status.

note.zh: 第二个公开批次；欧委会给予两个月回应期限。
note.en: The second public batch; the Commission gave the states two months to respond.

note.zh: 公开决定链条进入 CJEU 转交阶段，并提出罚款请求。
note.en: The public decision chain reached the CJEU referral stage with a request for financial penalties.

note.zh: 当前 27 国登记簿；当前状态与历史批次覆盖分开计算。
note.en: Current 27-state registry; current status is calculated separately from historical batch coverage.

summary.zh: 成员国应完成 NIS2 国内转置并向欧委会通知措施。
summary.en: Member States were expected to complete national transposition and notify the Commission.

title.zh: 欧委会对 23 国发出正式通知
title.en: Commission sent formal notices to 23 states

summary.zh: 公开决定登记簿新增首个 NIS2 侵权程序批次。
summary.en: The public decision register gained the first NIS2 infringement batch.

title.zh: 欧委会对 19 国发出理由意见
title.en: Commission sent reasoned opinions to 19 states

summary.zh: 19 国进入理由意见阶段；该历史覆盖与当前状态独立展示。
summary.en: Nineteen states entered the reasoned-opinion stage; historical coverage remains separate from current status.

title.zh: 爱尔兰、西班牙、法国和荷兰转交 CJEU
title.en: Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands referred to the CJEU

summary.zh: 欧委会公开了四国转交和罚款请求，登记簿将其标为当前重点关注。
summary.en: The Commission published the four referrals and penalty request; the registry marks them as the current attention queue.

title.zh: 登记簿刷新为 27 国国家矩阵
title.en: Registry refreshed as a 27-state country matrix

summary.zh: 补充国家页的转置状态、国家战略入口、主管机关、CSIRT 和 SPOC；缺失字段仍保持未提供。
summary.en: Country-page transposition states, strategy entries, authorities, CSIRTs and SPOCs were added; missing fields remain unavailable.
